summary: Linn County, OR ground site: camp 1912, cabin 600 ft west of the summit in 1916, abandoned in the 1940s, listed gone; no source describes it today.

facts.design: Cabin built 1916, about 600 feet west of the summit
facts.status_note: Forest Fire Lookout Association lists it as gone; the Forest Lookouts page says removed, with no date; no source describes the site today
facts.agency: Linn County Fire Patrol (Forest Lookouts page); Linn FPA (firelookout.com)

events.note: Cabin about 600 feet west of the summit
Source gives only 'Abandoned 1940s'; 1940 is the first year of that decade, not a dated record

evidence.supports: location: about 11 miles southeast of Sweet Home, Linn County
camp 1912, cabin 1916 about 600 feet west of summit, abandoned in the 1940s

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page says Linn County Fire Patrol; firelookout.com says Linn FPA. The two names appear to be the same patrol; the story uses the Forest Lookouts wording and cites both pages.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two short site pages and one index line. The 1916 cabin and the 1940s abandonment rest on firelookout.com alone; the 1912 alidade and the removal rest on the Rex page. Not used, because they belong to other records: the Douglas County Green Butte (Umpqua NF, 31S-3W-25; the 1932-1945 items on oregonlookouts.weebly.com/green-butte2.html) and the Lake County Green Butte (a 2022-23 visit reported on theroamingcivic.com; FFLOS US 2057, OR 570). Elevation 3,512 ft from firelookout.com is now in facts as elevation_ft (checked 2026-10-10).
